import sys, json, time, random
import numpy as np

def cost(p, A, B):
    return float(np.sum(A * B[p][:, p]))

def local_search(A, B, time_limit):
    n = len(A)
    p = list(range(n))
    random.shuffle(p)
    best = p[:]
    best_cost = cost(p, A, B)
    start = time.time()
    while time.time() - start < time_limit:
        i, j = sorted(random.sample(range(n), 2))
        p[i], p[j] = p[j], p[i]
        new_cost = cost(p, A, B)
        if new_cost <= best_cost:
            if new_cost < best_cost:
                best = p[:]
                best_cost = new_cost
        else:
            p[i], p[j] = p[j], p[i]
    return best, best_cost

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 3:
        return
    instance_path = sys.argv[1]
    budget = float(sys.argv[2])
    with open(instance_path) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    A = np.array(data["A"], dtype=int)
    B = np.array(data["B"], dtype=int)
    n = data["n"]
    perm, _ = local_search(A, B, budget)
    print("PERMUTATION: " + " ".join(str(x + 1) for x in perm))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
